Northstar Diagnostics Relay

Endpoint Active

This service receives telemetry and diagnostic data from internal Northstar tools, including remote desktop diagnostics and emergency rescue scripts. POST data to this URL to ingest status updates, host information, and recovery logs.

No interactive interface is required; all communication is handled by the diagnostics clients.

Endpoint: https://relay-north/intake
Method: POST
Accepted Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

For questions, contact the IT Operations team.
